 3h ago 
 -->
 We can now confirm the line-ups for our Premier League clash with Leeds United (kick-off 12.30pm).
 Roberto De Zerbi has made one change to the side that overcame Crystal Palace 2-0 last Saturday.
 Pedro Porro returns to our starting XI for the first time since our meeting with Aston Villa in September with Dominic Solanke set to begin the game amongst our substitutes.
 Joining him on the substitutes bench is Rodrigo Bentancur, who returns after completing his three-game suspension, while young goalkeeper Luca Gunter is named in a Premier League matchday squad for the first time.
 Starting XI: Kinsky, Robertson, van Hecke, Tel, Gray, Tonali, Fernandes, Kudus, Marmoush, Pedro Porro, van de Ven (c).
 Substitutes: Gunter, Senesi, Gallagher, Maddison, Solanke, Kulusevski, Bentancur, Davies, Williams-Barnett.
 -->
 Here's how our hosts line up...
 Starting XI: Trafford, Bogle, Gudmundsson, Ampadu (c), Muharemovic, Longstaff, Calvert-Lewin, Nmecha, Tanaka, Justin, Elvedi.
 Substitutes: Zetterer, Rodon, Hames, Wilson, Aaronson, Bijol, Okafor, Bard, Gruev.
